rationale.edition: All changed paths live under web/src/components/ (QueryEditor.vue, QueryEditor.spec.ts) — no enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/ directories are touched, so this is an OSS change. The code references config.isEnterprise and ai_enabled, which are enterprise-gating keywords, but they only gate the UI behavior from within the shared OSS component; path evidence is authoritative, so edition stays oss.
rationale.skip: Not skipped: the change is a real user-facing component edit (QueryEditor.vue), not docs/CI/comment-only, and there is no tests-added label or skip request in the trigger comment. The diff adds a Vitest unit spec (web/src/components/QueryEditor.spec.ts), which is dev test-maintenance — not a Playwright E2E spec — so the 'dev-authored tests are not an automatic skip' rule does not apply here.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: QueryEditor.vue changes when the AI input bar (data-test=query-editor-ai-input-bar) and floating AI toggle (data-test=query-editor-ai-toggle-btn) are shown. The new aiFeatureEnabled computed and the revised isAIMode logic gate the AI bar on enterprise + ai_enabled + auto-detected NL, which is a user-visible interaction flow that needs browser-level verification.
rationale.area: The QueryEditor is the SQL/natural-language query editor primarily surfaced in the Logs search page, and its AI input bar is a logs query-editor feature. The bulk of the UI change lives in web/src/components/QueryEditor.vue, and the sibling query-editor specs (logsQueryBuilder.spec.js, monaco-query-prefill.spec.js) live under playwright-tests/Logs, so Logs is the right area.
rationale.group: Logs-Features is the closest existing matrix shard: its run_files already include the query-editor-adjacent logsQueryBuilder.spec.js and monaco-query-prefill.spec.js, so the new queryEditorAiBar.spec.js fits alongside them in the Logs actual_folder without introducing a new shard.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff — the only test file changed is web/src/components/QueryEditor.spec.ts, a Vitest unit spec, which does not count as Playwright E2E coverage under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/. It also predates the new behavior's feature-level verification, so existing_tests_in_diff stays false.
